definitions.metric: Mean-side utilization: U=max(high-open,0)/forecast U distance; D=max(open-low,0)/forecast D distance. Larger utilization dominates. Wicks count; percentages are uncapped. Equal utilization is TIE.
definitions.horizon: Complete [03:00,05:00), [05:00,08:30), [08:30,16:00) NY windows; actual opening price is the anchor. No endpoint-opening candle included.
definitions.selection: Early windows: up to50 nearest earlier matches, same BBOX quarter and previous-hour behavior, five numeric inputs. NY: selected Own/Prior Exact/Wide quarter filters, earlier dates only. Mean only.
definitions.missing: Missing/incomplete windows and nonpositive forecast sides excluded; never turned into zero. Genuine zero excursion is included. Cohort sizes below50 retained with a flag and separate at-least50 results.
definitions.validation: First250 eligible chronological dates warm up; each later date uses only earlier U/D/TIE outcomes.20 baseline-equivalent shrinkage. Paired Brier loss differences;1000 circular10-day-block bootstrap replicates. Exploratory, not untouched holdout.
definitions.archive: Original close-count labels and counts retained as closeArchive. They are distinct v1 measurements and are not relabelled.
